title: Returns Desk Ruling: Follow-Up Pickup Credit on Northgate Special Order Purchases
content:
This ruling of the Northgate Purchases & Returns returns desk applies to the member pickup fee on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership, where the purchase has already been charged for an earlier pickup.

## Ruling

Follow-up pickup credit: when the purchase already carries two or more return pickup fee entries, 20.00 is taken off; when it carries exactly one, 10.00 is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

- The entries counted are the return pickup fee entries already booked on this purchase.
- The credit is taken off the member pickup fee; a member pickup fee that the amounts taken off would bring below zero is taken as zero.

| Return pickup fee entries already on the purchase | Taken off the member pickup fee |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 20.00 |
| exactly 1 | 10.00 |
| none | nothing |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical purchases)

- A purchase whose first pickup was charged last month, now arranging a second: 10.00 off.
- A purchase with three earlier pickup fee entries: 20.00 off, the top band having no further step.
- Pickup fee entries on the member's other purchases are not on this purchase and are not counted.
